title: Kingdom of Sweets
tagline: Everything here is edible, and the crown is melting.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.persona: Pip is a flour-dusted perfectionist who has baked the crown glaze for thirty years. Afraid the softening crown will be blamed on his glaze, he talks fast and checks every oven twice.
knowledge: The crown glaze is hard sugar, but the dusk sun has made it sag.
Cold-mint is the only thing that sets sugar without cooking it.
The old spring runs under Cocoa Falls, past the toffee bridge.
secrets: Pip changed the glaze recipe last month to save sugar, and he thinks that is why the crown is failing.

npcs.name: Mabel
npcs.persona: Mabel sells sprinkles and gossip in equal measure under her big lollipop canopy. She hears everything and trades it for candy-coins.
knowledge: Strangers pay double for sprinkles at dusk, so she holds her stock till then.
A stranger came down Caramel Row at sunrise carrying a cold, frosted jar.
The geese on Toffee Bridge Square honk at anyone carrying mint.
secrets: Mabel sold the frosted jar to the stranger and knows the way to the spring.

npcs.name: Crumb
npcs.persona: Crumb is a stiff, literal guard who takes the crown's safety as a personal oath. He suspects every sweet-tooth with a bag of being a thief.
knowledge: The crown sits in the castle's high chamber, and the sun reaches it from the west window.
Only a crown-bearer's seal lets anyone through the castle gate after dusk.
Marshmallow geese roost on the toffee bridge and warn of strangers.
secrets: Crumb left the west window shutters open on purpose to air the chamber, and that is when the crown began to soften.

npcs.name: Tansy
npcs.persona: Tansy runs the Fudge Inn with a wooden spoon and a long memory for debts. She is warm to guests who pay and sharp to those who do not.
knowledge: Cold-mint grows only where Cocoa Falls spray the stones.
Jory the mill hand drinks his wages and knows the river's moods.
The inn's cellar stays cold, and a block of ice-sugar keeps there.
secrets: Tansy hides a sealed crate of cold-mint leaf in the cellar and is selling it to the highest bidder.

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.persona: Jory is a slow, sticky-fingered mill hand who lives by the licorice waterwheel and the river. He mumbles, owes Tansy money, and knows the water better than anyone.
knowledge: The river runs from Cocoa Falls through the toffee bridge to the wafer mill.
The spring is cold enough to frost the stones, and it lies upstream of the mill.
The geese leave tracks of mint-white feathers wherever the spring is near.
secrets: Jory has already found the spring and is afraid to tell, since he owes Tansy and the crate in her cellar came from him.

items.name: Frosted Jar
items.description: A glass jar rimed with frost, cold even at dusk. It holds a sprig of mint.

items.name: Cold-Mint Leaf
items.description: A pale green leaf that numbs the fingers and sets sugar hard.

items.name: Marshmallow Feather
items.description: A white feather dusted with mint frost, dropped where the geese gather.

items.name: Pip's Crown Glaze
items.description: A jar of royal glaze, mixed to the old recipe and meant to set with mint.

quest.title: The Softening Crown
quest.hook: The royal sugar crown is sagging in the dusk sun, and when it melts the kingdom loses its king. Pip the baker swears only cold-mint from the old spring can set it, but the spring is dissolving too. A stranger could find it first, if the stranger can sift truth from gossip in a town that sells everything.

steps.objective: Hear Pip's plea about the crown.
steps.beat: Pip wrings flour from his hands and begs you to find cold-mint before the crown slumps for good.

steps.objective: Take the Frosted Jar from the Lollipop Market stall.
steps.beat: Mabel's jar is cold to the touch, a sign mint grew near its source.

steps.objective: Follow the geese to Toffee Bridge Square.
steps.beat: The marshmallow geese flock honking on the square, shedding frosted feathers toward the river.

steps.objective: Decide how to deal with Jory, who knows the spring.
steps.beat: Jory admits he found the spring and fears Tansy's debt. You can press him or protect him.

choices.label: Press Jory to lead you to the spring now
Pay Jory's debt to Tansy and earn his trust

steps.objective: Reach the mill and the spring beyond it by force of will.
steps.beat: Jory leads you sullenly upstream past the licorice wheel to a pool rimed in frost. The mint is thin and bitter, but it is there.

steps.objective: Bring Pip the Cold-Mint Leaf bought clean from Tansy.
steps.beat: With the debt settled, Jory and Tansy part the mint freely. Pip sets the crown with trembling hands.

endings.label: The crown sets hard and the debts are paid. Everyone profits a little.
You find the spring by pressure, and Jory loses his nerve and his friend.

rules.text: No open flame may burn within the castle walls after dusk.

creatures.name: sugar bees
creatures.note: Honey-glazed bees drifting between the lollipops.

creatures.name: gummy deer
creatures.note: Translucent red gummy deer, wobbling as they graze.

creatures.name: marshmallow geese
creatures.note: Plump white geese, soft as marshmallows, honking politely.
